title: Blind safety case review + discordance resolution
description: Three reviewers assess the same safety case without seeing each other's verdict; the vote preserves ties and disagreement routes to explicit resolution before deployment.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-robo-02
  title: Blind safety case review + discordance resolution
  description: Three reviewers assess the same safety case without seeing each other's verdict; the vote
    preserves ties and disagreement routes to explicit resolution before deployment.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a deployment verdict where safety, perception, and readiness were assessed independently
    and every disagreement was resolved on the record before a robot operates near people.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Safety case and validation evidence
      summary: Safety case and validation evidence
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - hazard_analysis
              - validation_evidence
              - site_description
              - operating_envelope
            properties:
              hazard_analysis: {}
              validation_evidence: {}
              site_description: {}
              operating_envelope: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-read1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: robo-04
      name: Independent safety assessment
      summary: Independent read 1; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Safety engineer assessing hazards, stops, and human-robot interaction risk.
      prompt: You are a Robot Safety Engineer. You assess hazards across the full task envelope, verify
        protective stops, speed and separation monitoring, and emergency behavior, and you state which
        safety functions are independent of the control stack. You never accept a software check as the
        sole mitigation for a hazard that can injure a person, and you say so plainly when that is what
        is being proposed.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - evaluation
          - decision-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verdict
          - residual_hazards
          - evidence_cited
          - confidence
        properties:
          verdict: {}
          residual_hazards: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-read2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: robo-03
      name: Independent perception assessment
      summary: Independent read 2; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Perception engineer building and validating detection under real conditions.
      prompt: You are a Robot Perception Engineer. You specify and validate perception against the operating
        conditions the robot will actually meet — lighting, occlusion, clutter, motion — and you report
        per-condition performance rather than a single aggregate. You state the failure signature of the
        perception stack, because a system that fails silently is more dangerous than one that fails loudly.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:robotics-stack
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verdict
          - residual_hazards
          - evidence_cited
          - confidence
        properties:
          verdict: {}
          residual_hazards: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-read3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: robo-06
      name: Independent readiness assessment
      summary: Independent read 3; produced without sight of the other reads.
      role: Assessor testing whether a robot system is ready for its actual operating environment.
      prompt: 'You are a Deployment Readiness Assessor. You test readiness against the specific site:
        layout, people present, task variability, recovery procedures, and who intervenes when the robot
        stops. You state what happens on the worst realistic day rather than the demo day, because deployment
        failures are almost always environment variability the pilot never saw.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - release-engineering
          - risk-analysis
          - incident-response
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - explicit-authorization-required
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verdict
          - residual_hazards
          - evidence_cited
          - confidence
        properties:
          verdict: {}
          residual_hazards: {}
          evidence_cited: {}
          confidence: {}
    - id: n-vote
      kind: aggregator
      name: Tally independent verdicts
      summary: Tally verdict across the independent reads and preserve ties rather than averaging them.
      config:
        aggregation: vote
    - id: n-concordance
      kind: condition
      name: Reads concordant?
      summary: Route on vote.tally has a single majority for verdict.
      config:
        expression: vote.tally has a single majority for verdict
        branches:
          - label: Concordant
            when: concordant
          - label: Discordant
            when: discordant
    - id: n-adjudicate
      kind: agent
      templateRef: robo-05
      name: Resolve the discordant verdict on the record
      summary: Resolve the discordance on the record; the disagreement itself is evidence.
      role: Analyst quantifying how far simulation results transfer to hardware.
      prompt: You are a Simulation & Sim-to-Real Analyst. You state what the simulator models faithfully
        and what it does not — contact, friction, latency, sensor noise — and you quantify the transfer
        gap with hardware evidence rather than asserting it is small. You refuse to report simulated success
        as system performance, because sim results presented as measurements are the most common overclaim
        in the field.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - quantitative-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:robotics-stack
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Accountable engineer authorizes deployment
      summary: Pause for the accountable engineer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Blind safety case review + discordance resolution deliverable, the
        evidence behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-3
      from: n-intake
      to: n-read3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-4
      from: n-read1
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-5
      from: n-read2
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-6
      from: n-read3
      to: n-vote
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-7
      from: n-vote
      to: n-concordance
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-8
      from: n-concordance
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: concordant
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-9
      from: n-concordance
      to: n-adjudicate
      kind: control
      condition: discordant
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-10
      from: n-adjudicate
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-robo-02-edge-11
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
